title: Quarantine-based suggestion orchestrator with operator handoff and rollback choreography
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a quarantine-first orchestration layer for Optimize recommendations that applies changes into an isolated runtime silo, validates them under simulated and sampled production traffic, then either escalates to operator handoff for gradual external rollout or executes automated rollback choreography when telemetry gates are violated. Goal is to enable safe auto-apply while minimizing blast radius and manual toil.
acceptance_criteria: Suggestions can be staged into a quarantine namespace without affecting customer routes
Automated simulation job runs against quarantined configs and reports delta metrics (latency, p99, error-rate, token-cost) within 30m
Telemetry gates (user-configurable) cause automatic rollback when thresholds breached
Operator handoff workflow posts a pre-filled review card to #optimize-ops with links to diffs, test traffic, and canary dashboards
Full rollout uses progressive percent-based routing with built-in circuit breaker and transparent audit trail
tasks: Design quarantine runtime abstraction (namespace + shadow routing) and API
Implement staged-config applier component with dry-run and apply endpoints
Build simulate-traffic job that replays representative prefix traces and adversarial cases
Wire telemetry gates into orchestration (latency, errors, model-Delta quality signals, cost)
Create operator handoff UI payload (Slack card + Console review link + one-click rollback)
Write automated rollback choreography with exponential backoff and stateful logging
Add acceptance tests and synthetic workload benchmarks
Author runbook and integrate with on-call paging for escalations
comments: 2026-02-26 - Maya Chen: Kicked off RFC doc for quarantine model. Initial architecture includes an isolated compute pool + shadow routing. Link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPT/Quarantine-Orchestrator-RFC

2026-03-02 - Arjun Patel: Spike complete for dry-run applier. Verified we can create a quarantined variant of a batching config and route 100% shadow traffic without touching live KV cache state. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/optimize-suggestion-orchestrator/pull/278

2026-03-04 - Sophie Ramirez (PM): Requested explicit telemetry thresholds to be configurable per-customer. Suggested defaults: +5% p50 latency, +2% error-rate, +3% token-cost. Also asked for a noise-tolerant smoothing window (5 mins).

2026-03-06 - Security review (Anika Bose): Need to ensure quarantine namespace cannot access customer PII and KMS keys are not used in simulation. Marked security_review_required=true and added checklist to Confluence.

2026-03-08 - Design review (Ethan Wu): Console UX for operator handoff card looks good. Ask: include a compact diff of active batching and cache TTL changes, and a link to a replay of synthetic traces.

2026-03-10 - Arjun Patel: Implemented telemetry gating proto. Integration tests flaked in CI due to timing sensitivity; added deterministic fixtures for latency patterns. Planning e2e run on staging tomorrow.

2026-03-12 - Maya Chen: Stakeholder sync with Platform SRE. Decided rollback choreography will include: immediate traffic cut to safe variant, snapshot of KV cache for forensic analysis, and a rollback ticket auto-created in Linear. Also agreed on default canary ramp: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with manual hold between steps unless all gates pass.
last_decision: Adopt quarantine-first pattern with simulated and sampled validation; default gating thresholds to be configurable per-customer and per-model. Operator handoff will be first-class with one-click rollback in Console and Slack integration.
outstanding_risks: Synthetic traces may not cover rare real-world prompt compositions leading to missed regressions
Quarantine compute pool could add cost overhead; need packing heuristics and preemption policies
Operator fatigue if false-positives happen frequently—threshold tuning and autopause needed
next_steps: Finish e2e staging run and collect telemetry from 48h run
Address CI flakes and increase fixture coverage for latency patterns
Complete Slack handoff payload and Console review link implementation
Schedule a security review follow-up to validate simulated traffic PII safeguards
